segments.text: "I hate my past."
The three most important things in her life are: Touko-oneechan, her brother, and swimming. If she somehow loses them all, what will she do? What can she do?
Hobbies: Swimming, Martial arts (just a little)
Likes: Swimming, being clingy, Touko and Yoshikazu
Basic Behavior: She always wears a bright smile and expresses herself as openly as she can.
Edited from MangaGamer
第三章登場のヒロイン。
第三章主人公・柾木良和の義理の妹。
家にこもりがちな兄と違い、元気いっぱいに夏の日差しをうけている水泳少女。透子と義兄の仲を取り持ったのも彼女である。
やたらと身体に触れることが好きで、すぐに腕を組んだり頬に触れたりしてくる。
この夏は、義兄の起こし方に凝っているらしい。
「あたしは、あたしの過去が嫌い」
彼女の大切なものは、みっつ。
透子お姉ちゃん。
お兄ちゃん。
そして、水泳。
──それらのものを失ったとき、僕は、そしてあいつは？

profileFacts.value: 水泳 　　ベタベタする事 　　透子と主人公

segments.text: She is a very eccentric-looking girl. Her name, age and nationality are all unknown. However, she seems to be looking for something so she prowls around the village. Contrary to her appearance, she acts very maturely. However, sometimes anachronisms show up in her conversation. For some reason, $1.00 equals 360 Yen in her mind. She also has an unbelievably huge appetite and even grills her favorite, corn on a cob, to enjoy by herself. She can always be found holding her stuffed animal, the cat "Archimedes".
Hobbies: Grilling corn, hanging Teru teru bozus (good luck charms for good weather)
Likes: Grilled corn, steamed rice, old love songs
Dislikes: Rain, fireworks (because they disappear too quickly)
Basic Behavior: Although she acts mature, she can be childish at times. She is always curious and hungry so she can easily be lured.
Edited from MangaGamer
神社の軒先で寝泊まりしていたのを、不憫に思い拾われてきた少女。
何かを探しているらしいのだが、探し物も自分の名前も忘れているために「お嬢」と呼ばれることになる。
とにかく大食らいだったり、すぐに姿を消したり、人の言葉を理解する猫のぬいぐるみ（アルキメデス）を持っていたりと、とにかく謎の少女。
エキセントリックな容姿の女の子。
国籍も年齢も名前も不明。
何か探しモノがあるらしく、村中をうろついている。
外見に似合わぬ大人びた言動なのだが、
時折、時代錯誤した会話をすることもある。
彼女の中では１ドル３６０円らしい。
信じられないくらい大飯ぐらいで、
大好物の焼とうもろこしは、
自分で七輪で焼いて食べていることもある。
腕に抱くのは、
相棒のぬいぐるみ“アルキメデス”くん。
腹話術（？）なのか会話もできる。

segments.text: "I'm so glad I got to see you again..."
One letter. Kazama Akira and Itsuki have parted once before. When they said farewell, she gave him a letter. Inside, there was one apology and one wish - "can I really make her wish come true?"

Itsuki is a soft-spoken girl that usually blames herself even for slightest mistakes. As a result Sayo often acts as her elder sister even though they were born at the same time as twins. She is often seen daydreaming or gazing at the stars in the night sky. She also likes to read doujinshi while ignoring everyone around her completely.

In reality, Itsuki was already dead prior to the present-day events in the game. She was killed by her father in an attempt to hide the witness to her mother's death (who was also killed by him). Her father attacked her with a shovel at the back of her head and buried both of them in the ground inside the forest behind the shrine. Because her soul didn't get carried away by a shinigami, she was trapped in the living world waiting for Akira's return several years later. Her reuniting with him released her from the world's bound and her soul was finally able to depart to the afterworld.
Hobbies: Reading, Stargazing, Doujinshi (Must be over 18!)
Likes: Her twin sister (Sayo-chan), animals, mysterious events
Basic Behavior: She appears to be docile, but is actually rather mischievous
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough
第一章登場のヒロイン。
常磐神社の巫女さん。漫画とアニメが好きで、少々オタク気味。
かつては内向的な性格だったが、村を訪れていた第一章主人公・風間彰という少年との出会いにより、前に進むための力を得た。
彰と伊月、そして伊月の双子の妹小夜は、ある果たせなかった約束を、今も胸に秘めていた……。
「……もう一度あなたに会えて、本当に良かった」
手紙。
伊月と主人公は、一度は別れました。
その際、主人公に託した手紙があるのです。
そこには、ひとつの謝罪とひとつの願いが書かれていました。
──俺は、本当に願いを叶えられたのか？

segments.text: Sayaka is a fine young lady often misunderstood, ignored and hated by the villagers of Tokiwa because of her father, Ritsu-sensei, who is an eccentric painter that excels in the art of "Death". His passion for painting has also passed unto Sayaka. The painting world became a sanctuary for Sayaka and she is often seen painting at her family's art studio together with her only trusted friend Kamishiro Souji. Despite her seniority over Souji, she sometimes acts like his junior even to the point of asking him to be her tutor. When she feels tired or has nothing else to do, she is always seen taking a nap in the hammock near her house.
Hobbies: Painting, naps (in a hammock)
Likes: Pumpkins, scarecrows (strange ones), long phone conversations
Basic Behavior: She is honest to herself, gets angry easily, and overreacts to things.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough
第二章登場のヒロイン。
死をテーマに絵を描く父親を持つために、村で孤立している少女。
そんな彼女は、持ち前の明るさで今日も元気に昼寝と散歩を繰り返していた。
だがこの夏、さすがに落第のピンチを迎えたさやかは、学園と美術講の後輩である第二章主人公・上代蒼司に家庭教師をお願いすることに……。
「死」をテーマに絵を描く偏屈な父親のために、
村八分にされているお嬢様。
薄倖そうな外見の可憐さとは裏腹に、
感情豊かで怒りっぽいため、
いじめも何も、平気へっちゃら。
頭の回転は早いのだが勉強が苦手。
その成績は紙一重で低い……。
このままでは落第してしまうので、
「後輩」である２章主人公に家庭教師を頼むことになる。
かかしとアクセサリーが大好きなのだが、
ひまわりが大嫌い。

segments.text: "You are the only one for me, but you are..."
The object of her desire - Masaki Yoshikazu. A feeling of relief. A feeling of conviction. The relief and conviction of knowing that she is loved. She is constantly seeking these things.
"You will not allow anyone else into my heart, will you?"

She loves Yoshikazu so much to the point of not letting him go anywhere alone by himself. However, she is also quite jealous of the fact that his sister Akane is living with him and sometimes is provoking him about it.
Hobbies: Reading, Indoor activities such as watching movies
Likes: Masaki Yoshikazu
Dislikes: Masaki Akane
Basic Behavior: She is always right next to Yoshikazu, even when they take a bath.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough
第三章主人公・柾木良和の恋人。
恋人である良和のことを一番に考え、その名の通り、彼の色に染まっていく透明な女性。
料理から洗濯まで家事は一通りこなせるが、性格の故かどれも際立っているということもない。可もなく不可もなく。
良和と仲のよい茜に、少なからず嫉妬を覚えているようだが……。
「……私にはあなただけ。でも、あなたは……」
求めて止まない対象──主人公。
そして、安心。確信。
自分が愛されている。
そんな安心と確信を、常に求めています。
──君は、君以外の人間を、僕の心に許さないのだろう？

profileFacts.label: 趣味
profileFacts.value: 読書 　　映画鑑賞などのインドア関連

segments.text: Souji is Sayaka's only trusted friend.
They grew up together and have known each other for a very long time.
Nowadays, they are both attending painting lessons at her father's art studio. Souji also has a younger sister that is at odds with Sayaka.

Masaki Yoshikazu is starting to feel a little awkward with his girlfriend, Kyouya Touko, and that awkwardness has something to do with his little sister, Masaki Akane. This awkwardness has become a dark spot in his heart which just keeps growing bigger and bigger. The relationship between Yoshikazu, Touko and Akane is heading in an unexpected direction.
Edited from MangaGamer

Inaba Hiroshi had to leave his home as a child and live in an orphanage due to his family-related problems. When he heard that his father became seriously ill, he came back to Tokiwa village on the night of Tanabata (Star Festival). During that night, Hiroshi met a mysterious girl that is holding a black stuffed cat-like toy. The strange girl wearing black clothes and a black hat doesn't remember her own name but none of that will stop Hiroshi from spending more time with the girl and her stuffed cat, Archimedes. Hiroshi's special summer like none other in Tokiwa has just began.
Edited from MangaGamer

Mishiba Ryousuke is an ill young guy suffering from severe psychological problems who escaped from his house confinement in search for freedom. On the night of his escape, he met a strange young woman at one of the cliffs of a neighbouring Tokiwa village. Very soon, they developed a certain relationship and neither of them will be happy to part away from each other.

Kiriko is a hostess of the "Naruto" inn. Hiroshi and Oujo are staying at her inn. She is always making sure that her guests are feeling like at home when they are staying in her inn. She is a very kind, funny and... forgetful woman.
She came to Tokiwa Village several weeks earlier than Oujo and like her,
she is also a nameless eccentric shinigami girl

. Unlike Oujo, she doesn't have a stuffed toy to carry around in her arms but she has a nice small pet bird that she carries on her shoulder and uses it for her ventriloquism. She had met Ryousuke one night while she was minding her own business at the so-called "suicide" cliff of Tokiwa village. In the nature of love on first sight, they immediately got very attached to each other, due to certain circumstances related to both of theirs psyches.
Edited from neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

A soft-spoken girl who politely addresses her older brother as Nii-sama. But that is just her outside appearance. Inside, she is just as dangerous as Kako with her sharp tongue. She also dislikes Sayaka to the point of calling her "otenko" ("Great Airheaded Girl").
Edited from neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

Kako is Hiroshi and Chitose's half-sister. She is a very loud tomboyish girl that enjoys watching baseball matches and drinking late at night in a village bar. She is deeply devoted to one of the baseball teams that isn't very succesfull at the moment. Also, she likes to tease Hiroshi at times but despite her unusual personality and behavior, she is a rather kind person towards her half-sister Chitose. She will prove to be a very reliable person once she becomes the head of their family.
Hobbies: Watching baseball in local bar, strolling around town insulting people (Akira in particular)
Favorites: Baseball, smoking, alcohol and other anti-straight edge things
Behavior: A horrible ice queen with slight tsundere-like attributes. She can insult people to the core, but she doesn't let the other way around. Of course, lots of people are like that.
Edited from neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

Mie is a loud, noisy and fussy girl. She has a sharp tongue and gets flustered easily. She is honest to herself and prone to argue. Also, she has developed very special feelings towards Souji ever since she met him one day at a field close to a mountain near Tokiwa village.
Hobbies: Cooking, karate, taking care of her siblings
Favorite: Starting a fight (especially with Sayaka)
Behavior: Noisy, loud, and fussy. Another girl who talks without thinking but also gets embarrassed easily. She usually says whatever is on her mind in open rather than hiding it.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

She has rather cold eyes and carries the image of a cool beauty but she is also very sensitive and quick to switch between these two aspects of her personality. She is a mysterious person who pops up throughout the Tokiwa village leaving warnings and predictions.

Chinatsu is actually Ojou's fragment of emotions for love and knowledge. Kako made a pact with Chinatsu after Chinatsu arrived in Tokiwa. Both of them can switch personae at any time as Chinatsu's control over Kako is limited.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

Sayo is Itsuki's twin sister. Unlike her sister, she is very sociable and cheerful. She acts like a big sister to everyone and won’t stand for injustice, but she often acts before she thinks. She also holds special feelings towards Akira, but...
Hobbies: Playing with animals, pulling pranks and protecting Itsuki
Favorites: Her twin sister (Itsuki), animals and Akira
Behavior: Unlike her counterpart, she is very straightforward and overfriendly but can also be very harsh at times, too. She often acts without any thinking. But that's how all kids are, right?
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

Chitose is Hiroshi's younger sister. She is very courageous and always puts others before herself. Since she is suffering from a serious heart defect, she can't even get out of her bed, but she is truly happy to hear that her brother returned to the village after such a long time. She can't make new friends because of her condition and so that's why she cherishes every moment that she can spend with her dearest brother and sister that are visiting her often. She will take a special liking to Oujo's stuffed cat-like doll, Archimedes.
Hobbies: Reading shoujo manga, playing girly games (ayatori, shiritori, etc.)
Favorites: Onii-chan, Onee-chan, Ojou-chan, Archimedes...-chan?

Basic Behavior: Although she is suffering from a heart defection and is unable to leave her bed without significant aid, that doesn't stop her from being brave enough to fight her disease. She also cares dearly for people close to her more than she cares about herself.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

Archimedes is a stuffed cat-like doll that Ojou carries around in her arms all the time. One of its strange abilities is that it is able to talk just like a normal human being albeit without opening its mouth. To a stranger, it appears like Ojou is using ventriloquism but that is not the case. It's not known why or how Archimedes is able to communicate with humans and its origin is certainly one big mystery. His main purpose appears to be that of Oujo's protector and a reliable traveling companion.
Kazama Akira recently came back to Tokiwa village with his mother. On his trip to the village shrine he was reunited with
his old childhood friend, Minase Itsuki. Their reunion brought back all kinds of memories from the times when they were still playing with each other and generally had a good time together
. As their past and present interweaves, what will the fate bring to them ... ?
Edited from MangaGamer
Kyoutarou is Mie's older brother. He is a psychologist at Tokiwa's hospital and he regularly gets visited by Yoshikazu.
He used to have a crush on Yoshikazu's girlfirend, Touko, but whether he got over it remains a question that only he can answer himself.

Ritsu is Sayaka's eccentric father who is infamous in the village as a painter that excels in the art of "Death". The villagers are repulsed by his "aura of death" and the bad reputation that is following him has also passed unto his daughter, Sayaka. There's a rumor circulating amongst the villagers that Ritsu prefers to "kill" his model for his painting in order to create a perfect work of art. He said once before that he wants Sayaka to be his model. This remark will not pass unnoticed by Souji and he will promise Sayaka that he would not let anyone kill her before his own death.
Edited from neo-X-saga's Walkthrough
